scene: the same small house party shown twice side by side like two frames of a film, identical people frozen in identical mid-toast poses in both halves with one tiny detail different between them, and in both halves the same reluctant guest stuck playing chess in the corner. two small bathrooms shown side by side in cutaway, in each one a person sitting and happily texting on their phone, nothing else explaining itself. No text or lettering anywhere.

several sleepers in a row of beds at night, their dream clouds overlapping into one large shared cloud, inside which small figures wander between the dreams and wave to each other. No text or lettering anywhere.

a group of friends posing for a photo in front of an utterly ordinary mailbox on a residential street, one consulting a giant unfolded map, one taking the photo very seriously, a corner store behind them. No text or lettering anywhere.

two clearly comfortable old friends at a restaurant table leaning in with first-date nerves, dressed slightly too nicely, hands almost touching beside the candle, an unmoved waiter in the background. No text or lettering anywhere.

friends sunk deep into a couch at night in lamplight, all gazing into the middle distance, one shared dreamy thought cloud floating above them holding a little ferry boat at sea. No text or lettering anywhere.
